## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `DeploymentPipelines`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `deployment-pipelines`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **DeploymentPipelines**.

## Step 2: Manage pipelines at the organization level

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. In the top navigation menu, select **Organization** list and select your organization.
3. In the left navigation menu under **Admin**, select **CD Pipelines**.

## Step 3: Create a pipeline

1. On the **CD Pipelines** page, select **+ Create Pipeline**.
2. <!-- manual: In the pipeline creation page, configure the following: -->
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 4: Assign a pipeline to a project

1. In the top navigation menu, select **Project** list and select the project you want to configure.
2. In the left navigation menu under **Admin**, select **CD Pipelines**.
3. <!-- manual: Add the pipeline to the project from the list of available pipelines. -->

## Step 5: Select a pipeline for an integration

1. <!-- manual: Open the integration and go to its Deploy page. -->
2. <!-- manual: Switch the active pipeline using the pipeline selector on the Deploy page. -->
